What are places to visit in Montgomery, Alabama?

message.content: Montgomery, Alabama has several places to visit, including the Alabama State Capitol, the Rosa Parks Library and Museum, the Montgomery Museum of Fine Arts, the East Chase Shopping Center, and the Montgomery Zoo.

There are a few places to visit in Montgomery, Alabama. First, you can visit the Montgomery Museum of Fine Arts. This museum is home to over 3,000 works of art. Second, you can visit the Alabama Shakespeare Festival. This festival has been around since 1979 and is the largest professional theatre in the Southeast. Third, you can visit the Rosa Parks Museum. This museum is dedicated to telling the story of Rosa Parks and the Civil Rights Movement.
